_about: Bricked Sorting V14 shared interface. All four module chats build to these numbers. Do not edit; request changes in your module README under INTERFACE REQUESTS.
version: v14-interface-2 (2026-11-05 18:20): two opposing drawers, drum kept at 160 x 180
axes: origin = floor center; +X right when facing the drawer; +Y toward the front (the drawer pulls out +Y); +Z up

roof.stud_L_(-260): open ring OD 312 ID 290, z 720..780, the hopper sits inside

zones.F_frame: walls, floor, deck panel, roof, studs, corner columns, bracing. Bracing must stay out of the D, S and K zones.

S_scoop.note: minus the corner columns; never below z 186 at any pose

plus: hopper inside stud L up to z 780 through the roof opening
drop funnel: cylinder r 30 at (330,0), z 366..390, through the deck hole

drawer.runners: single-stage printed with hard end stops and a closed detent
drawer.note: each bank (~5 kg loaded) fully clears its face at 220

scoop.dump_poses: carriage at each bins.x_centers[i], tilt toward -Y or +Y; the brick leaves the lip at |y| >= 95 and z >= 186 and lands inside the bin opening
scoop.park_pose: level, carriage at x 330, everything above z 186 (drawer may open)

bought_parts_allowed: electronics, motors, servos, switches, LEDs, 625ZZ bearings, GT2 6 mm belt + 20T pulleys + idler (scoop slide only), M3/M5 screws and nuts, M3 heat-set inserts, TPU/PTFE film. Everything else printed (no 2020 extrusion, no metal slides).

center_spine.note: free strip under the beam between the two drawers: F may put a structural spine here and D may bolt runners to its sides

service_clearance: 300 mm behind the machine for the back drawer
drum: keep the V13 drum as-is: 47b barrel 160 x 180 with helical flight, 49b static outlet plate (cradles new)

bin_ids.front: F1..F8, left to right as you face the front
bin_ids.back: B1..B8, left to right as you face the back
bin_ids.note: so B1 sits behind F8; numbering always reads left to right for the person at that drawer

side_marking: drawer faces in two filament colors (front and back), embossed F / B and 1-8 above each bin position, and a slide-in label card slot on each bin face for its category
